description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wathurugama, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511002
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels, their owners, property details, and legal determinations regarding land titles. The content is specifically published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land ownership matters, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette (Type 4).
